Each row's expected values are what Sage's real model factory, the OpenAI SDK and langchain-openai produced from the redacted body, projected onto what Sage's consumers read, on both client paths (they agreed).
provenance.substitutions: Lab host and user names renamed to WORKSTATION-A and lab.user; the two model names renamed to recorded-model-a and recorded-model-b (also inside error messages); echoed request parameters (tools, instructions, metadata, safety_identifier, user, prompt_cache_key, prompt_cache_retention, access_programs, billing) removed from 200 bodies. Substitution happened before replay. Provider ids, call ids, arguments, text and encrypted reasoning are otherwise unchanged.
provenance.synthetic: The replay prompt and the tool result in each history are synthetic placeholders.
provenance.gap: No Anthropic Messages body was recorded; that route is covered only by synthetic tests and the live check. Chat Completions success rows are listed under additions.
provenance.dedupe: Rows keep the first response per (API, status, model, output item types, function names, error code, error param).

additions.description: Chat Completions 200 rows recorded on 2026-11-26. Single-choice rows are recorded bodies from an OpenAI-compatible gateway and from OpenAI, frozen with today's projection. Each row names the versions it was frozen under.
